transitions._note: A=convex side. Beam enters convex first, exits flat. EFL = 14.95 mm, BFL = 11.58 mm (collimated y=1 → y_out=0.7748, θ_out=-0.0669; focus at y/|θ| = 11.58 mm past the flat vertex). Computed from R=7.7 mm, d=5.1 mm, n=1.515.

B=flat side. Beam enters flat first, exits convex. EFL = 14.95 mm, BFL = 14.95 mm (collimated y=1 → y_out=1.0, θ_out=-0.0669; focus at 14.95 mm past the convex vertex — for plano-convex the rear principal plane sits AT the convex vertex when entered flat-first).

notes.calibrationStatus: Paraxial thick-lens ABCD in [y, θ] convention (θ in radians, geometric translation d=5.1 mm). Geometry + index now match Thorlabs LA1540-B datasheet.
notes.thickLensDerivation: Convex-first: M_cf = M_flat_out · M_translate · M_convex_in = [[1,0],[0,n]] · [[1,d],[0,1]] · [[1,0],[-(n-1)/(n·R),1/n]]. Flat-first: M_fc = M_convex_out · M_translate · M_flat_in = [[1,0],[-(n-1)/R,n]] · [[1,d],[0,1]] · [[1,0],[0,1/n]]. With n=1.515, R=7.7 mm, d=5.1 mm.
notes.principalPlanes: EFL = R/(n-1) = 14.95 mm (≈15 mm spec). BFL_convex_first = EFL·(1 − d(n-1)/(n·R)) = 11.58 mm (Thorlabs spec ≈11.66 mm). BFL_flat_first = EFL = 14.95 mm (H′ at convex vertex for plano-convex flat-first).
notes.aberration: Phase 6 TODO: Seidel coefficient W_040 differs by orientation (convex-first has more spherical aberration). Not in current 5×5 paraxial model.
notes.alignmentError: 5th column of matrix5x5 is intentionally zero. Per-instance misalignment (Δx, Δy, Δθx, Δθy) is provided by the binding's local pose (localXMm/YMm/RxDeg/RyDeg) — the ray tracer transforms world→body via the binding pivot so an off-axis ray correctly enters the ideal 2×2 ABCD with the right (x, θx). Encoding misalignment in the matrix's 5th column (Siegman convention) would double-count.
notes.matrixHistory: 2026-05-A: Geometry updated to actual Thorlabs spec (d=3.6→5.1 mm, R=7.74→7.7 mm, n=1.5168→1.515). 2026-05: ABCD entries derived with consistent [y, θ] convention + geometric translation d (earlier asset mixed conventions and put d/n² in the B entry).
